crossRefs.note: For through the anger of Yahweh, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence.…
know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be…

parallels.note: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, worshiped other gods, and served…

translations.web: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”
translations.bsb: If you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from this good land He has given you.”
translations.kjv: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given
translations.asv: When ye transgress the covenant of Jehovah your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them; then will the anger of Jehovah be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
